scope: Merged working tree; macOS local-process verification, not Windows or public WAN evidence

remote.environment: darwin/arm64; separate processes, HTTPS relay over loopback; not a WAN test
checks: Paired device lease renewal is authenticated and repeatable
Pairing survives requester death and repeated approval creates one identity; mismatched fingerprint denied
Relay service credential cannot administer devices
Relay tickets cannot renew identity, mint tickets, or change role; storage grants cannot authenticate to relay
128 MiB relay upload/retrieval hashes match; killed downloader resumes durable bytes after relay restart
Wrong paired TLS key is rejected before creating output
Corrupt saved prefix is discarded and downloaded again with matching final hash
200 small files copied and retrieved through relay with all hashes verified
Fresh LAN candidate is authenticated and selected automatically; 200 direct file hashes match
Revoked device cannot obtain fresh remote access
Real server kill: pending catalogue, resumed bytes, verified 256 MiB retrieval
